blocks.content: To determine time differences between places.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Longitudes are essential for calculating local time across different regions.
They allow for the precise determination of time differences between distinct geographical locations.
Longitudes serve as the foundational system to establish standard time zones.

blocks.content: • To determine time differences between places.

items: Questions frequently test the primary function of longitudes, which is time calculation rather than temperature or climate zone determination.
Standard time in any region or country is established using specific reference longitudes.
